reason: Prelaunch review found that three refusal fixtures leave symlink or multi-link filesystem entries. The original native owner's final strict storage inventory would refuse release even if pytest passed.
test_changes: Resolve the unchanged source helper from its original frozen bundle.
For the symlink-directory test, remove only the same created alias in a finally block.
For the symlink-record test, remove only the same created link in a finally block; keep the original outside regular file and its bytes.
For the hard-link refusal test, remove only the extra created link in a finally block; keep the original journal as a single-link regular file.
Before unlink, compare exact original fixture device, inode, UID and file type and require current UID ownership. An unknown replacement is preserved and fails closed.
Keep all original refusal assertions and other test bodies unchanged. Preserve ordinary malformed/invalid journals for inspection.
